message: Wildcard agent permission grant detected. Scope the grant to specific tools or commands (e.g. Bash(git status:*), a named tool list); replace defaultMode bypassPermissions with a mode that asks (default or acceptEdits). Waiver: 'pragma: allowlist broad-agency' on the same line. A person's commit honours it; in the agent (write, the turn's end, an agent's commit) only a line already in HEAD counts, and the MCP gateway never does. An agent asks a person; it never writes the pragma.
